# Copper Scroll Column 10 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Copper Scroll Column 10 (treasure locations 43-50) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 10:1 — underground/subterranean + sepulchral/funerary/burial monument

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the great underground passage of the sepulchral monument" |
| LOGOS | "the great subterranean passage of the funerary monument" |
| PNEUMA | "the great passage beneath the burial monument" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "underground passage of the sepulchral monument" — "underground" is clearer than "subterranean" and "sepulchral" is the most precise rendering of the tomb-monument (nefesh).

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 10:2 — at/by the river/stream of Nataf

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "at the river of Nataf" |
| LOGOS | "by the river of Nataf" |
| PNEUMA | "at the Nataf stream" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "at the river of Nataf" — preserves the Hebrew construct chain nahar Nataf.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 10:7-8 — stater-weight rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "four bars of gold, stater-weight" |
| LOGOS | "four gold bars of stater weight" |
| PNEUMA | "four gold bars each weighing one stater" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "four gold bars of stater weight" — natural English while preserving the Greek unit. PNEUMA's "each weighing one stater" adds interpretive specificity.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:10 — cold-chamber/cold storage room

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the cold-chamber" — hyphenated compound for beit ha-qarar |
| LOGOS | "the cold-chamber" — same |
| PNEUMA | "the cold storage room" — expanded |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the cold-chamber" per EMET/LOGOS as a compact technical term.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 10:13 — In/At the Queen's residence

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "In the Queen's residence" |
| LOGOS | "In the Queen's residence" |
| PNEUMA | "At the Queen's residence" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "In the Queen's residence" per EMET/LOGOS — the Hebrew be- indicates interior location.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements in Column 10: 5*
